loinc_long_name: Urea [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

loinc_long_name: Urea [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

loinc_long_name: Glomerular filtration rate [Volume Rate/Area] in Serum, Plasma or Blood by Creatinine-based formula (MDRD)/1.73 sq M

loinc_long_name: Magnesium [Moles/volume] in Serum or Plasma

loinc_long_name: Phosphate [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

loinc_long_name: Bilirubin.direct [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma
ambiguita: Bilirubina diretta tradizionale (glucuronidata + delta-bilirubina, 1968-7) vs bilirubina coniugata pura senza delta-bilirubina (15152-2). La maggior parte degli analizzatori di chimica clinica misura la frazione diretta (1968-7). Scelto 1968-7.

loinc_long_name: Bilirubin.indirect [Mass/volume] in Serum or Plasma

loinc_long_name: Erythrocyte [Sedimentation Rate] in Blood by Westergren method

loinc_long_name: Bilirubin.total [Presence] in Urine by Test strip
